headline: Give Zigbee devices a home in Home Assistant
intro: Use a compatible Zigbee coordinator to build one wireless network for lights, sensors, switches, locks, and more. ZHA sets up the network and lets you pair devices directly, without relying on each manufacturer's gateway.
highlights: Pair compatible Zigbee devices through the Home Assistant interface
Choose from supported USB, serial, and network connected coordinators
Inspect network details and tune channel and device availability options
